cv.name: Nadia Lombardi
cv.headline: Chief Marketing Officer | Financial Services & Health | Brand-led Growth
cv.summary: Marketing executive with 17 years in consumer brands, lending and health insurance. Sits on the executive team of a member-owned health fund, leading brand, digital, member experience and a team of 38.

experience.title: Chief Marketing Officer
bullets: Lead brand, digital acquisition, CRM and member experience; team of 38 and A$21M budget
Repositioned the brand around preventative health; net member growth of 7% in a flat market
Moved 60% of media spend to digital channels with in-house performance capability
Board reporting on brand health, acquisition cost and retention

experience.title: Head of Marketing
bullets: Built the marketing function for a non-bank lender from three to fifteen people
Launched broker marketing program supporting A$1.2B in annual settlements

experience.title: Marketing Manager
bullets: Managed four wine brands across retail, export and cellar door

experience.title: Assistant Brand Manager / Brand Manager
bullets: Brand plans and launches for personal care products

certifications: Graduate, Australian Institute of Company Directors (GAICD), 2022
